Subject: POC next steps & environment options

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Below is a short recap, proposed success criteria, and three environment options so we can pick the fastest path to results for your eval.

Recap (from today)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference latency and cost for Acme's summarization pipeline on 150k tokens/day workload.
- Primary success criteria:
  1) 95th percentile response latency < 300ms for short queries (<= 200 tokens)
  2) End-to-end cost per 1M tokens delivered within 20% of our projection
  3) No functional regression on your reference prompt set (we'll run 1000 sample prompts)

Environment options (pros/cons):
1) Hosted sandbox (fastest) — Redwood-hosted, short-lived trial account with sample dataset. Pros: <48hr setup, no network changes, fastest to get metrics. Cons: data routed via Redwood hosted infra; not suitable if you require VPC-only access.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) — dedicated GPU pool in Redwood infra. Pros: closer to production perf, predictable throughput; Cons: ~1 week lead time for capacity reservation.
3) VPC trial (private deployment) — we deploy a trial environment in your VPC. Pros: data stays in your network, full parity with Private offering; Cons: network/infra coordination required, 2+ weeks for setup and approvals.

Redwood recommendation: Start with Hosted sandbox to validate performance and quality quickly (2 week run), then switch to a brief Dedicated or VPC pilot if you need production-like throughput or data residency.

Proposed next steps and owners
- Confirm preferred environment and POC owner from Acme (Sara/John) — action: reply with preference and availability
- Redwood to share success criteria doc, network checklist, and kickoff calendar invite — owner: Marissa (attached)
- If VPC chosen, Acme to loop in network/security and share firewall/IP allowlist — owner: John

Attachments: acme-poc-success-criteria.pdf (success criteria + eval plan), network-checklist.xlsx, redwood-dedicated-vs-vpc-one-pager.pdf

If you want, I can schedule a 30m kickoff to align owners and timelines — I have availability Wed Apr 7 or Thu Apr 8.
